mermaid:
---
title: Bookstore data model
---
erDiagram
  direction LR
  PUBLISHER ||--o{ BOOK : publishes
  BOOK ||--|{ BOOK_AUTHOR : "written by"
  AUTHOR ||--o{ BOOK_AUTHOR : writes
  BOOK ||--o{ ORDER_LINE : "ordered in"
  ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_LINE : contains
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
  BOOK ||--o{ REVIEW : receives
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes
  AUTHOR {
    uuid id PK
    string name
    string bio
  }
  BOOK {
    uuid id PK
    string isbn UK
    string title
    uuid publisher_id FK
    decimal price
    date published_on
  }
  BOOK_AUTHOR {
    uuid book_id PK,FK
    uuid author_id PK,FK
    int author_order
  }
  PUBLISHER {
    uuid id PK
    string name
    string country
  }
  CUSTOMER {
    uuid id PK
    string email UK
    string name
    string address
  }
  ORDER {
    uuid id PK
    uuid customer_id FK
    timestamp placed_at
    string status
    decimal total
  }
  ORDER_LINE {
    uuid order_id PK,FK
    uuid book_id PK,FK
    int quantity
    decimal unit_price
  }
  REVIEW {
    uuid id PK
    uuid book_id FK
    uuid customer_id FK
    int rating
    text body
    timestamp created_at
  }
